Vintage Spacecraft Instrument by Michał Wiśniewski, Poly Haven.
https://polyhaven.com/a/vintage_spacecraft_instrument
CC0 1.0 Universal: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Adaptations for liminal uwu: opaque housing, simplified Quest mesh, ambient occlusion baked into the shared color atlas, and metallic/smoothness repacking.
